When ignored the Synology integration, I see the following error message in the log:

    if self._host_already_configured(parsed_url.hostname):

review_comments: This is the case where it defaults to localhost when its missing?

The host is actually required, but it was to fix #34954 until we remove this function to check `_macs_already_configured` as agrred here https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/34888#issuecomment-622615865

Needed stuffs to get the MAC addresses are on 0.8.0 and updated in this PR #35068, and throught this was a breaking change.

But if you correct the MAC addresses, we actually don't need this PR.

(I hope I made myself clear :smile:)
I converted this to a draft so it doesn't merge as we should probably fix the duplicate discovery issue instead

Ok, 0.8.0 adds `dsm_api.network.macs` to do so 😉

Closing this PR
